display.purpose: Name picker heading only. The boarding moment — one screen, maximum presence.

title.purpose: Panel headings, day headings in Récap.

body.purpose: Item names, course names, button text. Semi-bold (600) is default.

label.purpose: Chips, nav links, presence names, secondary metadata.

caption.purpose: Section titles. All-caps with 0.10em tracking. Never below 11px.

shadows.name: shadow-sm
shadows.purpose: Default resting state for cards, inputs, chips.

shadows.name: glow-coral
shadows.purpose: Primary button resting glow. Lifts to 0 4px 14px rgba(224,64,16,.38) on hover.

shadows.name: focus-coral
shadows.purpose: Focus ring on primary-context inputs (name, item name).

shadows.name: focus-teal
shadows.purpose: Focus ring on secondary-context inputs (day fields, course fields).

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: All state transitions: hover, active, progress bar width.

motion.name: duration-enter
motion.purpose: fadeUp entrance animation on list items.

breakpoints.name: max-width
breakpoints.purpose: Single-column content max-width. No breakpoints — mobile-first single column throughout.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary action. Coral gradient, white text, warm glow. Scales down 3% on press.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #e04010 0%, #f5622c 100%); color: #fff; border: none; border-radius: 12px; padding: 11px 18px; font-family: 'Figtree', sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(224,64,16,.28); transition: box-shadow 150ms cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1), transform 150ms cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1), opacity 150ms; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(224,64,16,.38); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(.97); box-shadow: none; opacity: .88; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: .35; box-shadow: none; cursor: not-allowed; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(224,64,16,.35); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary action. White surface, warm border, lifts on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: #ffffff; color: rgba(26,16,8,.60); border: 1px solid rgba(90,55,20,.11); border-radius: 12px; padding: 11px 18px; font-family: 'Figtree', sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 1px 4px rgba(90,55,20,.07); transition: background 150ms, color 150ms, border-color 150ms; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: #f0ece4; color: #1a1008; border-color: rgba(90,55,20,.22); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(224,64,16,.20); }

components.name: Presence Button (off)
components.description: Full-width presence toggle at rest — not present. Looks like a ghost button.
components.css: .ds-btn-presence { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 100%; padding: 13px; background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid rgba(90,55,20,.11); border-radius: 12px; color: rgba(26,16,8,.60); font-family: 'Figtree', sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 1px 4px rgba(90,55,20,.07); transition: background 200ms, color 200ms, border-color 200ms, box-shadow 200ms; } .ds-btn-presence:hover { background: #f0ece4; color: #1a1008; border-color: rgba(90,55,20,.22); } .ds-btn-presence.on { background: rgba(0,137,111,.08); border-color: rgba(0,137,111,.24); color: #00896f; box-shadow: 0 2px 10px rgba(0,137,111,.12); }

components.name: Chip (person)
components.description: Presence name chip. 'Me' variant uses coral gradient.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-block; background: #f0ece4; color: rgba(26,16,8,.60); border: 1px solid rgba(90,55,20,.11); border-radius: 999px; padding: 4px 11px; font-family: 'Figtree', sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-chip-me { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #e04010, #f5622c); color: #fff; border-color: transparent; }

components.name: Item Card
components.description: Shopping list item with progress bar. done state uses emerald tint.
components.html: Eau minérale4 / 6 packs
components.css: .ds-item { background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid rgba(90,55,20,.11); border-radius: 12px; padding: 12px; box-shadow: 0 1px 4px rgba(90,55,20,.07); transition: border-color 200ms, box-shadow 200ms; } .ds-item:hover { border-color: rgba(90,55,20,.22); box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(90,55,20,.08), 0 8px 24px rgba(90,55,20,.05); } .ds-item.done { background: rgba(0,137,111,.08); border-color: rgba(0,137,111,.24); } .ds-item-top { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; margin-bottom: 8px; } .ds-item-name { flex: 1; font-family: 'Figtree', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 15px; color: #1a1008; } .ds-item-count { font-family: 'Syne', sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; color: rgba(26,16,8,.36); } .ds-item.done .ds-item-count { color: #00896f; } .ds-bar { height: 5px; background: rgba(90,55,20,.10); border-radius: 999px; overflow: hidden; } .ds-bar-fill { height: 100%; border-radius: 999px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, #e04010, #00896f); transition: width 350ms cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1); box-shadow: 0 0 5px rgba(0,137,111,.28); }

narrative.overview:
The system reads like a secluded golden-hour cove in Martinique — warm ivory sand, sun-bleached surfaces, coral fire and emerald water cutting through with full saturation. Every surface is light because light is the point: guests use this on their phones under direct Caribbean sun, and dark interfaces fail in that context.

Coral (#e04010) is the sun, used for every primary action, active state, and urgency signal. Emerald (#00896f) is the sea, used for confirmations, presence, and 'covered' states. The two converge on the progress bar horizon line. Motion is present but purposeful: staggered fadeUp entrances on lists create rhythm without choreography.
keyCharacteristics: Light-first: warm ivory canvas, white panels, warm-tinted shadows
Two saturated accents (coral + emerald) with a strict role split: coral = action/urgency, emerald = success/presence
Syne for all structural text paired with Figtree for all content
Tactile affordances: 36px minimum touch target, generous hit areas
Progress bar as the signature element: coral→emerald gradient, the horizon line between sun and sea

rules.name: The Horizon Rule
rules.body: The coral→emerald gradient appears in exactly two places: the progress bar fill and the 2px heading accent underline. Applying it anywhere else dilutes the metaphor.

rules.name: The Ink Tint Rule
rules.body: Every neutral is tinted toward warm brown (hue ~25–30). Pure #000, #fff, or #808080 are prohibited.

rules.name: The Syne Numeric Rule
rules.body: All quantities, counts, and progress labels use Syne even when surrounded by Figtree copy. Numbers are structural.

rules.name: The Flat-At-Rest Rule
rules.body: Cards and rows rest with Shadow SM and lift to Shadow MD on hover. Only panels use Shadow MD at rest.

dos: Do use Coral Fire (#e04010) exclusively for primary actions, active states, and urgency.
Do use Emerald Sea (#00896f) for all confirmations: presence on, item covered, done badges.
Do keep the coral→emerald gradient in exactly two places: progress bar fill and heading accent underlines.
Do use Syne for all quantity and count displays, even when surrounded by Figtree copy.
Do tint every neutral toward warm brown. Background, border, shadow, and ink all carry the same hue family.
Do give every interactive element a minimum 36px touch target.
donts: Don't reproduce the aesthetic of corporate dashboards (Linear, Notion, Jira). No cold greys, no flat-neutral surfaces.
Don't use generic SaaS UI patterns: hero-metric tiles, identical card grids, or modal-first interaction.
Don't use glassmorphism except on the nav. The frosted nav is purposeful; glass panels become decorative and expensive on mobile GPUs.
Don't use pure #000 or pure #fff for any text, background, or border.
Don't apply the coral→emerald gradient to text or decorative elements.
Don't use the danger color for missing item states. Coral handles urgency; danger is for destructive actions only.
Don't add bounce or elastic easing. All transitions use ease-out-quart curves.
